items.question: Which celestial and demonic figures are included among the attendants mentioned in this context?
premises: The preceding context describes an adorned setting with attendants.
Gandharvas and kinnaras are named as present beings.
A leader of daityas and a lord of danavas are also named.
items.inference: The attendants include both celestial beings and leaders of demonic groups.
uncertainties: Whether these figures are enumerated exhaustively or as examples is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: A gandharva, a kinnara, a leader of the daityas, and a lord of the danavas.
